sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Chinese incense cedar is an evergreen conifer native from southern China and Hainan through northern Indochina. It can reach about 35 m. Flattened sprays carry scale-like leaves; woody seed cones are small, roughly 10–20 × 4–6 mm, with four principal scales.

sections.title: Image and cones
sections.text: The plate's conical habit, flattened sprays and woody cones broadly match the species. Small yellow structures drawn along one spray are not identified in the sources consulted, so they are not labelled here as flowers.
